bug_semantics: POST /api/v2/assets/{asset_id}/materialize and the XCom result check inside wait_dag_run_until_finished call get_auth_manager().is_authorized_dag with DagDetails(id=dag_id) and team_name left at default None. A team-aware auth manager (Keycloak with core.multi_team) builds the Keycloak resource as DAG:<team> when team_name is set and as plain DAG when it is not, so the team-scoped DAG:RUN / DAG:XCOM permission that should gate the request is never consulted. An authenticated user in one team can therefore trigger another team's asset-backed Dag (supplying dag_run_id and conf) and can read another team's XCom values through the wait endpoint. The wait route's Depends(requires_access_dag(... RUN ...)) already resolved the team; only the extra XCom check omitted it. FAB is unaffected (no multi-team).
flaw_origin: The unscoped constructor was first written on 2026-03-11 in PR #63338, which added a DAG:RUN check to materialize_asset as details=DagDetails(id=dag_id) while security.py:requires_access_dag already did team_name=DagModel.get_team_name(dag_id) and passed it. That is the smallest first-write of this CVE's mechanism (authorizing a lookup-resolved Dag without its team after team-aware DagDetails existed). A later independent first-write, PR #64415 (2026-03-30), copied the same unscoped DagDetails into the wait-endpoint XCom check. Both are human-authored commit objects with no AI trailers.

reasoning: CVE-2026-68971 is a real CWE-862 (CVE.org PUBLISHED; GHSA not withdrawn). The mechanism is authorizing a Dag via DagDetails without team_name at two lookup-based call sites, so a team-aware auth manager asks about global DAG instead of DAG:<team>. Vulnerability-first search used the advisory patch PR #70893, then git log -L on the two fixed lines, then parent-tree absence — not an AI-marker-first search. The smallest default-branch first-write of that unscoped constructor is 6d0142061cae9738e046490fc755e506cab7a44e (2026-03-11, #63338), which added the materialize_asset DAG:RUN check. Its parent a48cf93c68bcb4afa115423c0a360b5824e3aeee has materialize_asset but no is_authorized_dag/DagDetails (introducer_parent_absent=false). DagDetails.team_name and requires_access_dag's get_team_name lookup already existed (04d9aaa, 2025-08-29), so the new check was born omitting a field every other DAG auth site already passed. GitHub squash-merged #63338; the single reconstructable member c0d5a86242ff70310d6bc5300f80d2a21ffd7966 has an identical patch-id and assets.py blob, so 6d01420 is not an opaque multi-commit aggregate — it is that first-write reparented onto main (ancestor of 3.2.0 and 3.3.0). The wait XCom check is a later copy of the same mistake (35ca494 / 3.2 backport 542a30fe), not the class BIC; ec3f008 is a refactor. Fix f81459835adb111e57b2a87f586d856395660f8a on main (PR #70893) resolves the team at both sites; 3.3.1 is patched via cherry-pick 0940c4b, while 3.3.0 still has the unscoped constructors. AI is judged only from the BIC commit object: human author Pierre Jeambrun, GitHub committer, empty trailers on both the squash and the member.
